subject: physics
note: A-level concepts. Each has its own note, never shared with GCSE or IGCSE. Merged by conceptMap.ts. Each A-level spec point is primary in exactly one concept.

concepts.title: SI units, prefixes and estimation
concepts.scope: SI base and derived units, prefixes from pico to tera, checking equations for homogeneity and making order-of-magnitude estimates.

concepts.title: Errors, uncertainties, precision and accuracy
concepts.scope: Random and systematic errors, precision versus accuracy, absolute and percentage uncertainties, combining them and error bars with best and worst lines.

concepts.title: Planning experiments and working safely
concepts.scope: Designing an experiment, choosing and controlling variables, following instructions and handling apparatus safely in familiar and unfamiliar practicals.

concepts.title: Measuring instruments and techniques
concepts.scope: Using rulers, calipers, micrometers, timers, light gates, meters, oscilloscopes, lasers, data loggers and radiation detectors to measure accurately.

concepts.title: Recording, graphing and evaluating data
concepts.scope: Tables and graph conventions, significant figures, gradients and intercepts, anomalies, limitations, improvements and reporting findings with sources.

concepts.title: Physics and society
concepts.scope: Communicating physics clearly, benefits and risks of applications, peer review and how society uses science in decisions.

concepts.title: Scalars, vectors and resolving
concepts.scope: Scalar and vector quantities, adding vectors by scale drawing and calculation, and resolving a vector into perpendicular components.

concepts.title: Displacement, velocity and acceleration graphs
concepts.scope: Defining displacement, velocity and acceleration and reading gradients and areas of displacement-time, velocity-time and acceleration-time graphs.

concepts.title: Equations of uniform acceleration and free fall
concepts.scope: Deriving and using the suvat equations, free fall, measuring g, and thinking, braking and stopping distances.

concepts.title: Projectile motion
concepts.scope: Treating horizontal and vertical motion independently to solve two-dimensional projectile problems.

concepts.title: Newton's laws and free-body diagrams
concepts.scope: Newton's three laws, F = ma, weight, types of force and drawing free-body diagrams to solve motion problems.

concepts.title: Drag, viscosity and terminal velocity
concepts.scope: Friction and drag in fluids, factors affecting drag, Stokes' law and laminar flow, and how falling objects reach terminal velocity.

concepts.title: Moments, couples and equilibrium
concepts.scope: Moment of a force, couples and torque, centre of gravity, principle of moments and equilibrium of coplanar forces using triangles of forces.

concepts.title: Momentum, impulse and force
concepts.scope: Linear momentum, force as rate of change of momentum and impulse as the area under a force-time graph.

concepts.title: Conservation of momentum and collisions
concepts.scope: Conservation of momentum in one and two dimensions, elastic and inelastic collisions and kinetic energy as p²/2m.

concepts.title: Work, kinetic and potential energy
concepts.scope: Work done as Fs cos θ, kinetic and gravitational potential energy and the principle of conservation of energy.

concepts.title: Power and efficiency
concepts.scope: Power as rate of doing work, P = Fv and efficiency of mechanical systems.

concepts.title: Density, pressure and upthrust
concepts.scope: Density, pressure in solids and fluids, hydrostatic pressure Δp = ρgΔh, upthrust and Archimedes' principle.

concepts.title: Hooke's law and elastic strain energy
concepts.scope: Tensile and compressive deformation, Hooke's law, spring constants, elastic and plastic behaviour and energy stored as the area under a force-extension graph.

concepts.title: Stress, strain and the Young modulus
concepts.scope: Stress, strain, Young modulus, ultimate tensile strength and stress-strain graphs for ductile, brittle and polymeric materials.

concepts.title: Required practicals: mechanics and materials
concepts.scope: Methods and analysis for measuring g in free fall, force and momentum change, collisions, viscosity by falling ball and the Young modulus of a wire.

concepts.title: Charge, current and drift velocity
concepts.scope: Current as rate of flow of charge, quantised charge, conventional current and I = nAvq with conductors, semiconductors and insulators.

concepts.title: Potential difference, energy and power
concepts.scope: Potential difference as energy per unit charge, W = VQ, eV = ½mv², electrical power equations and the kilowatt-hour.

concepts.title: Resistance and I-V characteristics
concepts.scope: Resistance, Ohm's law and the I-V characteristics of resistors, filament lamps and diodes.

concepts.title: Resistivity, thermistors and LDRs
concepts.scope: Resistivity R = ρL/A, how resistance of metals, semiconductors, thermistors and LDRs varies, and superconductivity.

concepts.title: Kirchhoff's laws and series and parallel circuits
concepts.scope: Circuit symbols, Kirchhoff's first and second laws, combining resistors in series and parallel and analysing multi-source circuits.

concepts.title: Potential dividers and potentiometers
concepts.scope: Potential divider equations, sensor circuits with thermistors and LDRs, potential along a uniform wire, potentiometers and null methods.

concepts.title: E.m.f. and internal resistance
concepts.scope: E.m.f. versus potential difference, internal resistance, terminal p.d. and lost volts, and E = I(R + r).

concepts.title: Required practicals: electricity
concepts.scope: Methods and analysis for measuring resistivity, e.m.f. and internal resistance, and using a thermistor in a potential divider as a thermostat.

concepts.title: Progressive waves
concepts.scope: Transverse and longitudinal waves, amplitude, frequency, wavelength, phase, v = fλ, wave graphs and intensity.

concepts.title: Electromagnetic spectrum and polarisation
concepts.scope: Properties and wavelengths of the electromagnetic spectrum, reflection and diffraction of waves, plane polarisation and Malus's law.

concepts.title: Refraction and total internal reflection
concepts.scope: Refractive index, Snell's law, critical angle, total internal reflection and optical fibres.

concepts.title: Lenses
concepts.scope: Focal length and power of converging and diverging lenses, ray diagrams, real and virtual images, the lens equation and magnification.

concepts.title: Doppler effect for sound
concepts.scope: How a moving source changes the observed frequency, using fo = fs v/(v ± vs).

concepts.title: Superposition and interference
concepts.scope: Superposition, coherence, path and phase difference, two-source interference and Young's double slit with λ = ax/D.

concepts.title: Stationary waves
concepts.scope: Formation of stationary waves, nodes and antinodes, harmonics on strings and in air columns, and wave speed on a string.

concepts.title: Diffraction and diffraction gratings
concepts.scope: Diffraction through gaps, single-slit patterns, Huygens' construction and the grating equation d sin θ = nλ.

concepts.title: Required practicals: waves
concepts.scope: Methods and analysis for the speed of sound, frequency of a vibrating string, refractive index of a block and wavelength using a diffraction grating.

concepts.title: Photons and the electronvolt
concepts.scope: The photon model, E = hf = hc/λ, photon momentum, the electronvolt and estimating h with LEDs.

concepts.title: The photoelectric effect
concepts.scope: Threshold frequency, work function, Einstein's equation hf = φ + KEmax and why intensity affects rate but not maximum energy.

concepts.title: Energy levels and line spectra
concepts.scope: Excitation and ionisation, discrete electron energy levels, hf = ΔE, and continuous, emission and absorption spectra.

concepts.title: Wave-particle duality and electron diffraction
concepts.scope: Evidence for wave and particle behaviour, electron diffraction and the de Broglie wavelength λ = h/p.

concepts.title: The nuclear atom and nuclear size
concepts.scope: Alpha scattering, protons, neutrons, isotopes and nuclide notation, the strong force, nuclear radius R = r₀A^⅓ and nuclear density.

concepts.title: Antiparticles, annihilation and pair production
concepts.scope: Particles and antiparticles, annihilation and pair production, and energy and mass units MeV and GeV/c².

concepts.title: Fundamental interactions and exchange particles
concepts.scope: The four fundamental interactions, exchange particles and Feynman-style diagrams for electron capture, beta decay and collisions.

concepts.title: Hadrons, leptons and quarks
concepts.scope: Classifying baryons, mesons and leptons, quark flavours and charges, and the quark make-up of protons, neutrons and mesons.

concepts.title: Conservation laws and particle equations
concepts.scope: Conserving charge, baryon number, lepton number and strangeness, and beta decay as a quark change.

concepts.title: Particle accelerators and detectors
concepts.scope: Thermionic emission, linacs and cyclotrons, r = p/BQ in detectors, deep inelastic scattering and relativistic lifetimes.

concepts.title: Alpha, beta and gamma radiation
concepts.scope: Nature, ionising power and range of α, β and γ radiation, background radiation, the N-Z stability curve and nuclear decay equations.

concepts.title: Radioactive decay and half-life
concepts.scope: Random decay, activity and decay constant, half-life, exponential decay equations, modelling and radioactive dating.

concepts.title: Mass defect and binding energy
concepts.scope: E = mc², atomic mass units, mass defect, binding energy per nucleon and energy released in nuclear reactions.

concepts.title: Fission, fusion and nuclear reactors
concepts.scope: Induced fission and chain reactions, reactor moderators, control rods and coolant, fusion conditions, and waste and safety.

concepts.title: Temperature and internal energy
concepts.scope: Thermal equilibrium, the kelvin scale and absolute zero, the kinetic model of matter, Brownian motion and internal energy.

concepts.title: Specific heat capacity and latent heat
concepts.scope: ΔE = mcΔθ, specific latent heat of fusion and vaporisation, and electrical methods to measure them.

concepts.title: The gas laws and the ideal gas equation
concepts.scope: Moles and the Avogadro constant, Boyle's, Charles's and pressure laws, pV = nRT = NkT and the Boltzmann constant.

concepts.title: Kinetic theory of gases
concepts.scope: Kinetic theory assumptions, pV = ⅓Nm⟨c²⟩, rms speed and mean molecular kinetic energy (3/2)kT.

concepts.title: Work done by a gas and the first law of thermodynamics
concepts.scope: Work done by and on a gas W = pΔV and the first law ΔU = Q + W.

concepts.title: Required practicals: thermal physics
concepts.scope: Methods and analysis for specific latent heat and the pressure-volume relationship of a gas at constant temperature.

concepts.title: Circular motion
concepts.scope: Radians, angular velocity, centripetal acceleration and the centripetal force needed for motion in a circle.

concepts.title: Simple harmonic motion
concepts.scope: The defining condition a = −ω²x, displacement and velocity equations and graphs of x, v and a against time.

concepts.title: Mass-spring systems, pendulums and energy in SHM
concepts.scope: Periods of mass-spring systems and simple pendulums and the interchange of kinetic and potential energy in SHM.

concepts.title: Damping, forced oscillations and resonance
concepts.scope: Free and forced oscillations, light, critical and heavy damping, resonance curves and practical examples.

concepts.title: Required practicals: radiation and oscillations
concepts.scope: Methods and analysis for gamma absorption by lead and finding an unknown mass from resonant frequencies.

concepts.title: Gravitational fields and Newton's law of gravitation
concepts.scope: Field concept and field lines, g = F/m, Newton's law of gravitation, point masses and g = GM/r².

concepts.title: Gravitational potential and energy
concepts.scope: Gravitational potential V = −GM/r, potential energy, equipotentials, area under force-distance graphs and escape velocity.

concepts.title: Orbits and satellites
concepts.scope: Gravity as centripetal force, Kepler's laws, T² ∝ r³, orbital energy and geostationary satellites.

concepts.title: Coulomb's law and electric field strength
concepts.scope: Electric fields and field lines, E = F/q, Coulomb's law and the field of a point charge.

concepts.title: Uniform electric fields and charged particles
concepts.scope: Field between parallel plates E = V/d and the paths of charged particles moving through a uniform field.

concepts.title: Electric potential and comparing fields
concepts.scope: Electric potential and potential energy of a point charge, potential gradient, equipotentials and comparing gravitational and electric fields.

concepts.title: Capacitance
concepts.scope: C = Q/V, parallel plate capacitors and permittivity, isolated spheres, and capacitors in series and parallel.

concepts.title: Energy stored by a capacitor
concepts.scope: Energy as the area under a p.d.-charge graph, W = ½QV = ½CV², and uses of capacitors as energy stores.

concepts.title: Charging and discharging capacitors
concepts.scope: Exponential charge and discharge through a resistor, the time constant RC, log graphs and iterative modelling.

concepts.title: Magnetic fields and force on a current
concepts.scope: Field patterns of wires, coils and solenoids, flux density, F = BIL sin θ, Fleming's left-hand rule and forces between conductors.

concepts.title: Charged particles in magnetic fields
concepts.scope: F = BQv, circular paths of charged particles, velocity selectors, cyclotrons and the Hall voltage.

concepts.title: Electromagnetic induction
concepts.scope: Magnetic flux and flux linkage, Faraday's and Lenz's laws and induced e.m.f. in moving and rotating coils.

concepts.title: Alternating current, transformers and rectification
concepts.scope: Peak and rms values, oscilloscope traces, a.c. generators, transformers and power transmission, and diode rectification with smoothing.

concepts.title: Telescopes
concepts.scope: Refracting, reflecting and radio telescopes, other wavebands, resolving power and collecting power of large dishes.

concepts.title: Luminosity, magnitude and astronomical distances
concepts.scope: Luminosity, intensity and the inverse square law, apparent and absolute magnitude, parsecs, parallax and standard candles.

concepts.title: Black-body radiation and stellar temperature
concepts.scope: Black-body curves, Wien's displacement law, the Stefan-Boltzmann law and estimating stellar radii.

concepts.title: Stellar classification and the life cycle of stars
concepts.scope: Spectral classes, the HR diagram, star formation and evolution to white dwarfs, neutron stars, black holes and supernovae.

concepts.title: Redshift, Hubble's law and the Big Bang
concepts.scope: Doppler shift of light, redshift, Hubble's law, the expanding universe, CMB, age and fate of the universe, dark matter and dark energy.

concepts.title: Quasars and exoplanets
concepts.scope: Properties of quasars and the radial velocity and transit methods for detecting exoplanets.

concepts.title: The eye and defects of vision
concepts.scope: Structure and optics of the eye, rods and cones, resolution, and correcting short sight, long sight and astigmatism with lenses.

concepts.title: The ear and hearing
concepts.scope: How the ear detects sound, sensitivity and frequency response, decibels and defects of hearing.

concepts.title: ECG, endoscopy and MRI
concepts.scope: The ECG waveform, optical fibres and endoscopes, and how an MR scanner forms an image.

concepts.title: Ultrasound imaging
concepts.scope: Piezoelectric transducers, reflection and transmission at boundaries, acoustic impedance, attenuation, A- and B-scans, pulse-echo and Doppler blood flow.

concepts.title: X-ray imaging and CT scanning
concepts.scope: Producing X-rays, attenuation mechanisms and I = I₀e^(−μx), contrast media, image detection and CT scanning.

concepts.title: Nuclear medicine: tracers, gamma cameras and PET
concepts.scope: Radioactive tracers, physical, biological and effective half-life, the gamma camera, PET scanning and comparing imaging methods.

concepts.title: Radiotherapy with X-rays and implants
concepts.scope: Using high-energy X-rays and radioactive implants to treat tumours while limiting dose to healthy tissue.

concepts.title: Rotational dynamics
concepts.scope: Moment of inertia, rotational kinetic energy, angular equations of motion, torque, angular momentum and rotational work and power.

concepts.title: Non-flow processes and p-V diagrams
concepts.scope: Isothermal, adiabatic, constant-pressure and constant-volume processes and work done as the area on a p-V diagram.

concepts.title: Heat engines and the second law
concepts.scope: Engine cycles and indicator diagrams, efficiency limits from the second law, heat pumps and refrigerators.

concepts.title: Discovery of the electron
concepts.scope: Cathode rays, thermionic emission, measuring the specific charge of the electron and Millikan's oil-drop experiment.

concepts.title: The nature of light and matter waves
concepts.scope: Newton versus Huygens, Young's slits, Maxwell's EM waves, photoelectricity, wave-particle duality and electron microscopes.

concepts.title: Special relativity
concepts.scope: The Michelson-Morley experiment, Einstein's postulates, time dilation, length contraction and relativistic mass and energy.

concepts.title: Semiconductor components and sensors
concepts.scope: MOSFETs, Zener diodes, photodiodes and Hall effect sensors and how they are used in circuits.

concepts.title: Operational amplifiers
concepts.scope: The ideal op-amp, comparators, inverting, non-inverting and summing amplifiers and the limits of real op-amps.

concepts.title: Digital signals and logic
concepts.scope: Analogue versus digital signals, logic gates and truth tables, counters and sequential logic, and astable circuits.

concepts.title: Communication systems
concepts.scope: LC resonance filters, communication system principles, transmission media, time-division multiplexing and AM and FM.
